content.scenario: The Central Authority prepares its annual statement of accounts, which needs to be certified by the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India.
content.outcome: The Comptroller and Auditor-General of India prescribes the form and manner of the annual statement of accounts in consultation with the Central Authority, and certifies the accounts after audit.

user_queries: What is the role of the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India in relation to the Central Authority's accounts?
How are the accounts of the Central Authority certified?
Can the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India inspect the offices of the Central Authority?
